hvpSystems.name: Commercial Continuous Conveyorized Underwater Arc Hydrodynamic Tenderizer (ASME Section VIII Div 1)
hvpSystems.classification: Industrial Primal Cut Meat Tenderizer (USDA FSIS Directive 7120.1 / CE Pressure Equipment Directive)
hvpSystems.membraneBarrier: Sanitary Acoustic-Transparent Polyurethane Flexible Isolation Diaphragm (FDA 21 CFR § 177.2600)
hvpSystems.description: High-throughput continuous conveyor system for whole beef chuck rolls, briskets, and pork loins. Parabolic acoustic reflectors focus 250 MPa underwater shockwaves through a sanitary isolation membrane, instantly fracturing muscle myofibrils without heating meat.

hvpSystems.name: High-Throughput Continuous Electrohydraulic Slurry Extraction Skid (AISI 316L Flow-Through Reactor)
hvpSystems.classification: Green Botanical & Agro-Industrial Waste Extraction System (3-A Sanitary / EHEDG Class I)
hvpSystems.electrodeMaterial: Titanium-Ruthenium Oxide Coated Dimensionally Stable Electrodes (DSA)
hvpSystems.membraneBarrier: Direct Submerged Coaxial Discharge with In-Line Microfiltration & Metal Ion Trap (< 0.01 ppm W/Cu)
hvpSystems.description: Continuous flow-through electrohydraulic reactor designed for wine grape pomace, berry presses, and microalgae slurries. Generates intense microsecond cavitation shockwaves to permeabilize tough cellulose cell walls for 45% higher polyphenol yield.

hvpSystems.name: Sanitary Acoustic Shockwave Shellfish & Oyster Shucking Module (FDA Seafood HACCP Compliant)
hvpSystems.classification: Continuous Cold Mollusk Meat Separation System (NSR Sanitary Standard)
hvpSystems.membraneBarrier: Stainless Wire Belt with Chilled Saline Fluid Couplant
hvpSystems.description: Non-thermal shockwave shucker for live oysters and scallops. Exploits acoustic impedance mismatch at the shell-adductor interface to cleanly release muscle attachments with 0% meat cooking or gaping.

hvpSystems.name: Pilot Multi-Arc Hydrodynamic Research Chamber with Optical Quartz Schlieren Windows
hvpSystems.classification: Food Physics Laboratory Scale Research Platform (IEC 61010-1 Electrical Safety)
hvpSystems.membraneBarrier: Interchangeable Acoustically Matched Thin Films (PE, TPU, Mylar)
hvpSystems.description: Precision experimental chamber fitted with high-speed shadowgraph and piezoelectric hydrophone arrays (PCB Piezotronics 109C11) to study shockwave propagation, rise time, and bubble collapse kinetics in biological tissues.

foodSubstrates.name: Beef Semitendinosus (Eye of Round Primal Cut)
foodSubstrates.description: Dense, high-collagen bovine muscle notorious for tough texture. Underwater shockwave pulses fracture I-band filaments and weaken perimysial connective tissue, cutting chewiness in half instantly.

foodSubstrates.name: Spent Laying Hen Breast Meat (High Mature Pyridinoline Collagen)
foodSubstrates.description: Mature poultry meat from spent laying flocks, typically relegated to low-value rendering due to tough, heat-stable collagen crosslinks. HVP shockwaves disintegrate myofibrils into tender value-added deli fillets.

foodSubstrates.name: Pork Loin Longissimus Dorsi (Pale, Soft, Exudative PSE Mitigation)
foodSubstrates.description: High-value pork cut where excessive toughness can lead to consumer rejection. Shockwave tenderization tenderizes muscle without increasing drip loss or affecting blooming color.

foodSubstrates.name: Red Wine Grape Pomace & Skin Residue (Cabernet / Merlot)
foodSubstrates.description: Viticultural press cake containing dense plant cell walls. Supersonic hydrodynamic shockwaves and micro-cavitation create nano-pores, accelerating solvent-free solid-liquid extraction of resveratrol and anthocyanins.

foodSubstrates.name: Chlorella vulgaris Microalgae Cellular Slurry (Algaenan Cell Wall)
foodSubstrates.description: Microalgae protected by an extremely tough algaenan and sporopollenin cell wall. HVP hydrodynamic shockwaves induce instantaneous cell wall shear and rupture without solvent toxicity.

foodSubstrates.name: Live Eastern Oyster (Crassostrea virginica Shellfish)
foodSubstrates.description: Bivalve mollusk shucking using acoustic shear stress generated at the calcium carbonate shell to adductor muscle tendon interface. Shell opens cleanly with zero heat damage.
